snippet.title: Wyrmspan - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST WYRMSPAN ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3339080?utm_source=mc_youtube&utm_campaign=wyrmspan_reveal&utm_medium=video&utm_content=reveal_trailer

Wyrmspan is an engine-building, card-driven strategy game for 1 to 5 players. Play as an amateur dracologist discovering a world of dragons. Excavate caves and explore your sanctuary. Entice dragons and chain their abilities to create powerful combos.

Official Discord: https://discord.gg/wingspan
Official Wingspan Page: https://www.monstercouch.com/wyrmspan/
